text: In this single galaxy of ours there are eighty-seven thousand million suns. [...] The planets you may one day possess. But the stars are not for man.
author: Arthur C. Clarke

text: By the time you're my age, you'll realize that everything you once thought mattered so much turns out to mean very little.
author: Liu Cixin

text: When you compare the sorrows of real life to the pleasures of the imaginary one, you will never want to live again, only to dream forever.
author: Alexandre Dumas

text: Sospecho, sin embargo, que no era muy capaz de pensar. Pensar es olvidar diferencias, es generalizar, abstraer. En el abarrotado mundo de Funes no había sino detalles, casi inmediatos.
author: Jorge Luis Borges

text: The most important thing in the world is to learn how to give out love, and to let it come in.
author: Morrie Schwartz

text: We are all just walking each other home.
author: Ram Dass

text: An archaeologist is the best husband a woman can have. The older she gets, the more interested he is in her.
author: Agatha Christie

text: The past is never dead. It's not even past.
author: William Faulkner

text: Not all those who wander are lost.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien

text: La memoria es un espejo que escandalosamente miente.
author: Guillermo Cabrera Infante
